responsibilities: Continuously improve and add value to existing data products used company-wide, such as Socrates, Basic Tables, Semantic Layer, and various dashboards.
Utilize technologies like AI/LLM to build a mechanism that automates the entire data modeling lifecycle, from identifying opportunities for optimization through to design and implementation.
Define and implement a semantic layer to act as a Single Source of Truth (SSoT) for both humans and AI, thereby reducing the risk of decisions based on incorrect data.
Develop a business metadata foundation to convert department-siloed knowledge (such as marketing strategies) into a common, company-wide asset.
Collaborate with corporate functions (e.g., HR, Finance) to transform department-specific operational data into data products, thereby enhancing the cross-functional decision-making foundation.
Building an autonomous system where AI continuously drives the data modeling lifecycle.
Architecting a semantic layer from the ground up to serve as a single, reliable source of truth for both people and algorithms.
